title: Sync consumer identity, current cursor and explicit acknowledgement v1
description: Complete current-cursor or acknowledgement success envelopes. A current cursor is consumer state, not an original command receipt, stream high-water mark or proof of local persistence.
$comment: Source-only schema matching sync-command-context.ts identity and sync-cursor.ts. Runtime additionally checks UTF-16 limits, Unicode scalars, ordinary finite JSON, depth 64/100000 nodes, exact original identity/scope/trace/target/source equality and valid calendar expiry. Shared parser budgets are 16 KiB request and 32 KiB complete success. JSON Schema does not authenticate a consumer, establish future permission or prove a write outcome.

identifier.$comment: isSyncIdentifier additionally rejects lone surrogates and measures UTF-16 units. DEL and literal dot identifiers are not rejected by this generic event identifier; scope narrows dot values separately.

identityText.$comment: Actor/client/trace text: preserve exact original string, no trimming. Runtime rejects lone surrogates and counts UTF-16 units.

timestamp.$comment: Exact valid UTC millisecond round-trip is required by the parser. Unlike some item-history timestamps, this parser does not accept extended years. Expiry still being future is enforced separately by the caller/handler.

SyncCommandIdentity.description: Exact five-field original consumer identity. General identifiers, not necessarily ULIDs. It supplies equality preconditions, never credentials or identity overrides.

SyncCursorQuery.description: SDK/MCP local selection; HTTP GET has no query/body fields. Original scope goes in scope headers and optional actor/client precondition headers. Gateway command input must be empty.

SyncCursorHttpQuery.description: Empty decoded HTTP query. The local optional identity is not a URL query or GET body.

SyncAcknowledgement.description: Explicit saved identity and exact nonnegative target. No client_id alias, request key, expected_version, event payload or implicit current-session substitution. Server cannot prove the caller persisted the corresponding pages.

cursorSource.$comment: Exactly identity.client_id + ':' + String(cursor); client IDs may themselves contain colons. No URI decoding, parsing of a different identity or revision field.

SyncCursorEnvelope.$comment: server_cursor=data.cursor. No record is false/0/empty sources; recorded confirmation of zero is true/0/one source. Identity matches scope and any saved expected identity; trace is this read. Permissions/expiry are current session hints. No revision/etag/server high-water or original request history.

SyncAcknowledgementEnvelope.$comment: Identity equals original expected_identity; data.client_id=identity.client_id; both cursors equal original requested target; source binds that client/target. Complete response is prepared before writing, returned after commit and session check. No original request key, replay flag, expiry, revision or ETag. Another acknowledgement may advance current state afterward.
